source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: fintech AND (inclusion OR society OR regulation OR households OR poor)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:fintech AND (inclusion OR society OR regulation OR households OR poor),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("fintech" AND ("households" OR "inclusion" OR "poor" OR "regulation" OR "society"))
